description: This service enables you to create supplier invoices through an API call from a source system outside SAP S/4HANA. Furthermore, the service enables you to read, release, reverse, delete, and post existing supplier invoices from the SAP S/4HANA system. The service is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed in apps and other user interfaces. This service allows you to create multiple supplier invoices. The service supports a deep create of an invoice only, this means, all nodes can only be created as part of a deep create. Executing multiple deep creates as part of one changeset is not supported.
